# <span id="aanchor447"></span> Edit Reason Editor

Accessing this form requires **Application Process - FLOWCAL Options** privileges.

In many FLOWCAL editors, you will need to select a reason for an edit before you can save the change. These edit reasons provide context when the reason for revising data (such as equipment failure or crude analysis data) is not obvious.

The Edit Reason Editor allows you to create custom edit reasons that are then available for selection throughout FLOWCAL.

Multiple users can access and edit this screen simultaneously; however, if multiple edits are made to an edit reason at the same time, only the latest set of changes will be saved.

<div class="procedure">

To access the Edit Reason Editor:

1.  Go to **Settings** \> **Settings Manager**.
2.  Select **Edit Reason** within the **Application** group.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 562;height: 403;" />

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Details">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Edit Reason Editor Menu Details</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Details">

Users must have at least **FLOWCAL Options - Can View** privileges to access these options. Additional privileges required for edit, disable/restore, and create functionalities are listed in the corresponding sections.

The following options are available in the right-click menu of the Edit Reason Editor:

- **Sort Ascending** - Sort notes by the selected column in ascending order.
- **Sort Descending** - Sort notes by the selected column in descending order.
- **Show Search Panel** – Launch the search panel to show edit reasons with a code or description that match specific criteria.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 582;height: 103;" />

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Create">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Create Edit Reasons</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Create">

This functionality requires **Application Process - FLOWCAL Options - Can View**, **Can Edit**, and **Can Create** privileges.

<div class="procedure">

To create a new edit reason:

1.  Click the **Add Edit Reason** button.
2.  Enter a new edit reason and code.
3.  In the Object Type drop-down menu, check the **Meters/Tickets**, **Sources/Samples**, or **Exceptions** checkboxes to make the edit reason available for those object types.
4.  Click the **Done** button to save your changes.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 355;height: 211;" />

The Code, Edit Reason, and Object Type fields are all required. If you create an edit reason with a code that has already been assigned, you will not be able to save the edit reason until you enter a unique code. Edit reasons can be modified at any time; however, the code cannot be edited once it has been saved.

</div>

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Disable Enable">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Disable/Enable Edit Reasons</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Disable Enable">

This functionality requires **Application Process - FLOWCAL Options - Can View**, **Can Edit**, and **Can Delete** privileges.

<div class="procedure">

To disable an edit reason:

1.  Select the edit reason to disable.
2.  Click the **Delete** button.
3.  When prompted to confirm disabling the edit reason, click **Yes**.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 589;height: 421;" />

Disabling edit reasons will hide them but will not delete them from the database. This allows the edit reasons to remain in the database for audit purposes.

To enable edit reasons that have been disabled:

1.  Click the **Show disabled edit reasons** checkbox.
2.  Select the edit reasons that you want to enable.
3.  Click the **Restore** button.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 577;height: 411;" />

</div>

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Sort">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Sort Edit Reasons</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Sort">

<div class="procedure">

To sort edit reasons:

- Click any column heading in the grid to sort the edit reasons by that parameter. Click the up and down arrows in the column header to change the sort order from descending to ascending. By default, edit reasons are sorted by code number, in descending order.
- Change the column order by selecting a column header and dragging and dropping the column to a new location.

</div>

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Filter">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Filter Edit Reasons</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Filter">

You can filter edit reasons by a single column or multiple columns.

<div class="procedure">

To filter edit reasons by a single column:

1.  Hover over a column header until the filter icon displays.
2.  Click the filter icon to open the Filter dialog box.
3.  Click back on the grid to close the Filter dialog box. Use the filter bar at the bottom of the screen to view or edit the filter directly.

</div>

</div>
